messages:
michelle: Heads-up: starting an 'attest & prune' sweep focused on cross-account admin roles, long-lived service-account keys, and KMS grants that allow external principals. Goal: reduce blast radius before the external compliance review. Flow: scan -> owner attestation (short form) -> canary -> staged removals with reapply playbooks.

ryan: Love the attestation step. Can we require a 2-field form: reason + recovery owner (email)? That makes audit evidence cleaner.

celine: Also we should flag principals that only show console logins but no API calls (possible human-driven access) vs pure API usage for thresholding.

audit-bot: preflight-scan: 2,030 principals inspected, 138 admin-like bindings, 46 cross-account KMS grants, 27 long-lived svcacct keys. Snapshot: gs://compliance-snapshots/2468002468/before.json (immutable). Link: https://internal/reports/attest-prune-2468002468

michelle: Canary plan: pick 6 low-risk bindings across infra/analytics/partners; demote admin->viewer for 48h and monitor error rates and job success. If canary OK, proceed with phased batches. All changes logged and tied to attestation records.

infra-bot: automation will respect tag `attest:hold=true` and ticket-based exemptions. Webhook posted to #eng-oncall for any canary anomalies.

ryan: KMS safety: before touching key IAM, run an impersonated decrypt probe for every service principal flagged. Example probe:
```bash
# impersonate and attempt decrypt
gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=kr --key=k --ciphertext-file=/tmp/ct --project=proj --impersonate-service-account=${PRINCIPAL} || echo "decrypt-failed"
```
If probe fails mark `needs-owner-attest` and do not auto-remove.

celine: For long-lived service keys we rotate keys as part of removal plan: create new key, update dependent services (using reapply_playbook), then revoke old key. We'll include `reapply_command` in CSV for each principal.

michelle: Owner ping (attestation) template: "Hi @owner, security scheduled an entitlement review. `<principal>` has `<role>` on `<resource>` and appears inactive or cross-account. Please complete short attestation form: https://forms.internal/attest?case=2468002468 within 7 days with: (1) reason for access, (2) recovery owner. No response -> automated demotion. Reply here if special handling needed"

compliance: Please ensure immutable snapshots and attestation records are locked (retention 7y). Auditor will request per-principal justification during the review.

michelle: Action items:
- audit-bot: export CSV with principal, role, last_seen, kms_crossacct_flag, key_age, attestation_url (ETA: Tue)
- ryan: implement form + webhook that writes attestation to ticketing system (ETA: Tue)
- celine: KMS probe harness + reapply_playbook commands (ETA: Wed)
- infra-bot: implement `attest:hold=true` tag detection and pause automation hook (ETA: Wed)

michelle: ETA for first canary: next Wednesday 10:00 PT. Keeping this thread pinned for live runbook updates. React with :shield: if you've read. "
